description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker nemotron-3-super-nvfp4 recipe for NVIDIA's NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 (NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License; checkpoint revision ff433f54) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: CUTLASS MoE backend, TRITON_ATTN attention, FP8 KV cache, float32 mamba SSM cache, InstantTensor loading, prefix caching, qwen3_coder tool-call parser, nemotron_v3 reasoning parser, 262,144-token context, ten sequences and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults), with VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND=trtllm and VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1. Tensor parallel 2 across the pair uses vLLM's native multi-node launch, eugr's default no-Ray cluster mode, so upstream's --distributed-executor-backend ray is dropped. The 80 GB checkpoint fits one Spark, so both topologies apply. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B NVFP4 CUTLASS vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
